d:
Thick, voluminous curls of deep mahogany brown hair that cascade down the back with a messy, natural texture. Warm amber eyes with a wide, curious expression. Appears to be in the late teens with a youthful, soft-featured face. Slender and athletic build, wearing a traditional Shuriman-inspired ensemble of creamy beige fabrics and weathered brown leather straps. Accessories include a turquoise beaded necklace and several small, polished stone ornaments woven into the hair.
BODY COLOR: olive
